test_window.why_359_days: 365 calendar days minus the six dates absent from the frozen input archive.

scoring.cohort: Extended feature table: elevation > 0, k_mean or k_gfs non-null, actual/capacity in [0,1]; main_v2 drops rows missing any Elia P10/P50/P90 and restricts the test window. All exported calibrated Penumbra and Elia quantiles are non-null, so report() scores identical rows.
scoring.units: Capacity, actual and all forecasts are MW; elevation_deg is degrees; losses and widths are capacity shares.
scoring.normalisation: Divide actual and each forecast by the monitoredcapacity for that timestamp and scope from ods032.
scoring.pinball: Equal mean of max(q*(actual-forecast), (q-1)*(actual-forecast)) for q=0.1,0.5,0.9, then mean across rows.
scoring.mae: Mean absolute error of P50, after per-row capacity normalisation.
scoring.coverage: Inclusive actual >= P10 and actual <= P90; preserve calibrated bounds without sorting/clipping.
scoring.width: Mean of (P90-P10)/capacity; preserve signed calibrated widths as scored.
scoring.provinces: Pool all 11 provincial scopes with equal weight per row; no averaging of provincial means or MW weighting.
scoring.daily_file: One row per UTC date and individual scope, sums and means in capacity shares. Provinces daily means pool sums/counts across provincial scopes.

ci.method: Paired daily pinball differences (Penumbra minus Elia), equally weighted UTC-day means sampled with replacement.
ci.rng: numpy.random.default_rng (PCG64), reset separately for each scope

rounding.validation: Every reference metric, CI and relative change matches at published precision; all binary coverage/below/above flags match row by row.

data_licences.data: Elia actual observations, monitored capacities and day-ahead P10/P50/P90
data_licences.changes: Selected common daylight intervals, added Penumbra model predictions, converted predictions to MW, rounded fields, and aggregated daily losses.

model_outputs: Penumbra calibrated P10/P50/P90 outputs; no model training or meteorological source files are redistributed in this pack.
capacity_provenance: Exact timestamp/region one-to-one join to archived ods032; actual and all Elia normalised quantiles match the frozen grid bit-for-bit before rounding.
hash_scope: SHA-256 and byte lengths of every other evidence file; MANIFEST.json is excluded to avoid a self-referential hash.
